findings.title: Contact sanitization removed a material dual-enrollment eligibility answer

This is lost eligibility scope, rather than excluded contact scope.

Add a held typed eligibility qualifier distinguishing degree-credit enrollment, AP courses, and the conditional high-school/part-time-college exception; retain the source's qualified wording. Update artifact hashes, evidence references, applicable next actions, README and semantic verification.
